# Asymmetrix

> Asymmetrix is a B2B market intelligence platform focused on the Data & Analytics (D&A) industry — covering data, research and content providers of every shape, size and business model. It gives PE firms, venture investors, M&A advisors and operators proprietary intelligence on companies, deals, investors and people shaping the sector, unified under a single consistent taxonomy.

## Key facts

- Tracks 6,550+ Data & Analytics companies (public, PE-owned, VC-backed, private, subsidiary and acquired).
- Covers 3,636 investors (PE firms, venture investors and corporate investors) active in Data & Analytics.
- Covers 290 M&A advisors active in the space.
- Tracks 5,708 corporate events (acquisitions, investments, IPOs, sales, partnerships, strategic reviews and divestments) in Data & Analytics.
- Every company sits within a single, consistent D&A taxonomy spanning data, research and content sub-sectors.
- Publishes original research reports and market commentary on valuations, consolidation and disruption across the sector, including an AI Exposure Index assessing individual companies' AI risk and defensibility.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com): Overview of the Asymmetrix platform and what it covers.
- [About Us](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/about-us): Background on Asymmetrix and its mission.
- [Companies](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/companies): Directory of Data & Analytics companies tracked by Asymmetrix.
- [Investors](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/investors): Directory of PE firms, venture investors and corporate investors active in Data & Analytics.
- [Advisors](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/advisors): Directory of M&A advisors active in Data & Analytics deals.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/corporate-events): Deal and transaction history across the Data & Analytics sector.
- [Individuals](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/individuals): Leadership and people data linked to Data & Analytics companies.
- [Sectors](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/sectors): The Asymmetrix Data & Analytics sector taxonomy.
- [Insights & Analysis](https://www.asymmetrixintelligence.com/insights-analysis): Research reports and market commentary on Data & Analytics M&A, valuations and disruption.
